scenario: [LTIM.14.2] with [LTIM.1.1.5] and [LTIM.1.2.2]: a call whose fields are in range and whose value is outside its type's range raises NOT_REPRESENTABLE and never wraps, and no step of computing a value in range overflows. The first `Time` is 1677-09-21T00:12:43.145224192Z, so that day's midnight is below the int64 minimum while its later instants are not; the last is 2262-04-11T23:47:16.854775807Z; the `Date` range is 1677-09-22 through 2262-04-11. One `F` fact per case, its fields in `Int` slots so nothing folds, each pumped on its own. A raising case has its own rule, `f.id == N and <the call> != <a constant>`, which never fires; `trapped` logs the fault's kind. A value in range is written by its own rule through `::String`. In order: `calendar.time(1677, 9, 21)` raises (1); `calendar.time(1677, 9, 21, 0, 12, 44)` is `1677-09-21T00:12:44Z` (2); `calendar.date(1677, 9, 21)` raises (3); `calendar.date(1677, 9, 22)` is `1677-09-22` (4); `calendar.time(2262, 4, 11, 23, 47, 16, 854775807)` is the last instant, `2262-04-11T23:47:16.854775807Z` (5); one nanosecond more raises (6). The discriminators: a runtime that formed the day's midnight first raises at 2, or wraps it; one that checked the calendar and not the range writes 1, 3 or 6. PATH PINNED: libds `adapter_ds_calendar_time` (the day before the epoch reached from the next midnight, under `__builtin_mul_overflow` / `__builtin_add_overflow`) and `adapter_ds_calendar_date` (`ds_date_days_in_range`), rete/adapters.c; Mercury `ds.chrono.ltim_14_2_time` (the instant in `integer`) and `ltim_14_2_date`.
rules_ds:
import calendar

schema F scope logical:
    id: Int key
    y: Int mutable
    mo: Int mutable
    d: Int mutable
    h: Int mutable
    mi: Int mutable
    s: Int mutable
    ns: Int mutable

rule time_before_the_range:
    F f where f.id == 1 and calendar.time(f.y, f.mo, f.d) != calendar.time(1970, 1, 1)
->
    log info "built 1"

rule first_day_late:
    F f where f.id == 2
->
    let t = calendar.time(f.y, f.mo, f.d, f.h, f.mi, f.s)::String
    log info "{t}"

rule date_before_the_range:
    F f where f.id == 3 and calendar.date(f.y, f.mo, f.d) != calendar.date(1970, 1, 1)
->
    log info "built 3"

rule first_date:
    F f where f.id == 4
->
    let t = calendar.date(f.y, f.mo, f.d)::String
    log info "{t}"

rule last_instant:
    F f where f.id == 5
->
    let t = calendar.time(f.y, f.mo, f.d, f.h, f.mi, f.s, f.ns)::String
    log info "{t}"

rule time_after_the_range:
    F f where f.id == 6 and calendar.time(f.y, f.mo, f.d, f.h, f.mi, f.s, f.ns) != calendar.time(1970, 1, 1)
->
    log info "built 6"

rule trapped:
    ComputationError c
->
    log info "{c.kind}"
